sections.title: 研究方法

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Prediction of stroke-associated pneumonia (SAP) and hemorrhagic transformation (HT) is critical for improving the prognosis of acute ischemic stroke patients.

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】During pre-training, RKMM segments WMH masks from the MRI sequence to steer the model toward WMH regions, enabling it to learn meaningful representations of these clinically relevant pathological areas.

evidence.text: Prediction of stroke-associated pneumonia (SAP) and hemorrhagic transformation (HT) is critical for improving the prognosis of acute ischemic stroke patients.

During pre-training, RKMM segments WMH masks from the MRI sequence to steer the model toward WMH regions, enabling it to learn meaningful representations of these clinically relevant pathological areas.
